# Camp Resource: ArmCo Ammunition Construction Appliance

The ArmCo Ammunition Construction Appliance will generate ammo of your choice and is only placeable at C.A.M.P.

Can not be placed in Shelters.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

**ArmCo Ammunition Construction Appliance**

**Produces**

Ammo

.308 Round

.38 Round

.44 Round

.45 Round

.50 Cal Round

10mm Round

5.56 Round

5mm Round

Fusion Cell

Gamma Cell

Plasma Cartridge

Shotgun Shell

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

0 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

None

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

**Holds**

.308 Round - 166 rounds

.38 Round - 333 rounds

.44 Round - 250 rounds

.45 Round - 333 rounds

.50 Cal Round - 200 rounds

10mm Round - 200 rounds

5.56 Round - 200 rounds

5mm Round - 1000 rounds

Fusion Cell - 200 rounds

Gamma Cell - 100 rounds

Plasma Cartridge - 33 rounds

Shotgun Shell - 166 rounds

**Obtainable via**

Gold Bullion - Mortimer - Ally - 750 Bullion

**Produces X amount per**

.308 Round - 1 round every 1.44 minutes

.38 Round - 5 rounds every 1.44 minutes

.44 Round - 2 rounds every 1.44 minutes

.45 Round - 2 rounds every 1.44 minutes

.50 Cal Round - 1 round every 3 minutes

10mm Round - 5 rounds every 1.44 minutes

5.56 Round - 5 rounds every 1.44 minutes

5mm Round - 5 rounds every 1.44 minutes

Fusion Cell - 1 round every 1.44 minutes

Gamma Cell - 1 round every 1.44 minutes

Plasma Cartridge - 1 round every 1.44 minutes

Shotgun Shell - 1 round every 1.44 minutes

**Lockable**

Yes

**Power Required**

No

**Flamingo Units**

7 Flamingo Units
